Given I am on the IBC milestone tracker, When the page loads, Then I should see all the required IBC milestone elements displayed
Given I am on the Name/SID column, When I click the downward arrow, Then the names should be displayed in ascending order
Given I am enrolled in a programId==IBC/NDPP, When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week1, Then I should be marked as having achieved milestone M0 and milestone M1
Given I have achieved M0 & M1 now, When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week2, Then I should be marked as having achieved milestone M2
Given I have achieved M0 & M1, M2 now, When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week3, Then I should be able to achieve First green for M3
Given I have achieved M0 & M1, M2, M3(firstgreen) now, When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week4, Then I should be able to achieve Second green for M3
Given I have achieved M0 & M1, M2, M3(firstgreen), M3(secondgreen) now, When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week5, Then I should be able to achieve M4
Given I have achieved M0 & M1, M2, M3, M4, When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week6, Then I should be able to achieve M5(firstgreen)
Given I have achieved M0 & M1, M2, M3, M4, M5(1stgreen), When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week7, Then I should be able to achieve M5(secondgreen)
Given I have achieved M0 & M1, M2, M3, M4, M5(1st & 2ndgreen), When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week8, Then I should be able to achieve M5
Given I have achieved M0 & M1, M2, M3, M4, M5,, When I achieve Weekly Meaningful Engagement for week9, Then I should be able to achieve M6
